scope: three-minute Fast Fiction Factory narrative candidates
quarantined_signature: nineteen-shot exhaustive chronology used as a mandatory three-minute structure
twenty-cue coverage as a completeness target
more than three unexplained proper names or institutions
successive unresolved hypotheses without concrete information gain
production-state wording used as story progress
a closing choice not earned by an enacted event
a candidate that is neither explicitly a digest, trailer, PV, nor complete short story
quarantined_components: nineteen-shot chronology as mandatory three-minute structure
preserved_components: existing source package and its historical evidence

change_management.current_state: public Git storage; product remains unreleased
change_management.migration: use the public candidate ref and exact commit identity
change_management.rollback_boundary: Git history remains intact; do not rewrite or force-push

change_management.current_state: coherent candidate isolated on the dedicated branch
change_management.migration: resolve the external candidate only by its ref and exact commit
change_management.rollback_boundary: restore only through a new forward commit after separate authority

change_management.prior_state: stale historical MP4 with an empty subtitle track
change_management.current_state: coherent candidate MP4 with eleven corrected review-caption cues
change_management.migration: bind review to candidate artifact, commit, MP4 SHA256, and package fingerprint
change_management.rollback_boundary: the historical MP4 remains obtainable only as history, not current review evidence

change_management.prior_state: live successor and shared master routes
change_management.current_state: successor null on master; routes are candidate-local
change_management.affected_consumers: manifest, MkDocs, state dispatcher, tests, and review links
change_management.migration: remove live master consumers and use the external candidate locator
change_management.rollback_boundary: no merge, cherry-pick, default promotion, or shared dispatcher without new authority

reuse_policy: Quarantined narrative text and structure must not be copied into active review or production tracks. Visual bytes and the terminal-frame transition method remain reusable under their existing boundaries.
